title: Language-Statistical Analysis of Neural Audio Codec Tokens Across Architectures, Corpora, and Noise Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2608.31037v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural audio codecs (NACs) convert speech into discrete token sequences, and prior work has reported that these sequences follow language-like statistical laws. This paper analyzes the token statistics of 13 NACs spanning multi-codebook residual vector quantization (RVQ), single-codebook VQ, and non-VQ designs, evaluated on three corpora under clean, white-noise, and real-world DEMAND-noise conditions. Zipf and Heaps parameters, unigram entropy, codebook occupancy, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) are estimated from matched token samples with explicit fit-validity safeguards and family-conditional $n$-gram orders. Corpus identity explains little variance in any metric, whereas acoustic condition and quantizer meta-category dominate in a metric-dependent way, and unigram entropy is the metric most strongly associated with meta-category. Clean-to-noise JSD computed at a common unigram order is associated with mel-cepstral distortion mos

translated_title: 跨架构、语料库与噪声条件的神经音频编解码器令牌的语言统计分析
translated_abstract: 神经音频编解码器（NACs）将语音转换为离散的令牌序列，先前的研究已报告这些序列遵循类语言的统计规律。本文分析了13种神经音频编解码器的令牌统计特性，涵盖多码本残差向量量化（RVQ）、单码本VQ以及非VQ设计，并在三个语料库上于干净、白噪声和真实世界DEMAND噪声条件下进行评估。研究基于匹配的令牌样本，采用明确的拟合有效性保障措施和基于家族条件化的n-gram阶数，估计了Zipf和Heaps参数、一元熵、码本占用率以及Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）。结果表明，语料库身份对各指标的方差解释力很小，而声学条件和量化器元类别则以依赖于具体指标的方式占主导地位，其中一元熵是与元类别关联最强的指标。在共同一元阶数下计算的干净到噪声条件的JSD与梅尔倒谱失真和MOS相关。
tldr: 该论文对13种不同架构的神经音频编解码器令牌进行了系统的语言统计分析，发现声学条件（尤其是噪声）和量化器类型而非语料库内容才是决定令牌统计特性的主导因素，且干净与噪声条件间的JSD与语音失真指标相关。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes the language-like token statistics of 13 neural audio codecs across architectures, corpora, and noise conditions, showing that acoustic condition and quantizer type—rather than corpus identity—dominate token statistics, with clean-to-noise JSD correlating with spectral distortion measures.
